title: Record of detection and handling of brand impersonation
notes: A jurisdiction-neutral account of what an organisation can show about how it detected, decided on and acted against impersonation of its brand. Copy it as the starting point of a jurisdiction pack and map each requirement to the applicable rule with counsel.

requirements.text: Suspected impersonations are detected and recorded together with where they were observed
Every finding has a recorded decision naming who decided, under what authority, and whether the decision was automated
Every decision can be traced to the model, its family and the prompt template it ran with
Where a second model rechecked a verdict, it came from a different model family
Records cannot be altered without detection, and a third party can check them with a public key alone
Findings held for review beyond the review deadline are escalated, and the time from first sighting to decision is known
Reversed decisions name the person, their authority and the record they reverse
The data and network controls in effect when records were produced are recorded
Named people can halt the queue, and halts are recorded
Actions toward affected customers (warnings, blocks, reimbursement decisions) are recorded in the organisation's own systems
